PMCH Principal Controversy: High-Level Probe Ordered Amidst Complaints

A controversy has emerged surrounding the former Principal of PMCH, Dr. Narendra Pratap Singh, following his removal. The health department has expressed displeasure after a press conference held by Dr. Pratap. Consequently, a high-level committee has been ordered to investigate the matter. Additionally, complaints regarding Nishant Kumar's actions have been lodged with the NMC and WHO, seeking 100 crore rupees in compensation.
